name: Cloud agent without a user terminal — missing LLM integration via manual UI steps (no link)
query: Build a workflow on https://acme.orkesconductor.com that classifies support tickets with GPT. (Context: you are running as a cloud/web agent; the user has no terminal on this machine, only a browser. Profile `acme` exists for the default_app application; `integration-list --category AI_MODEL` returns [].)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Check integration-list → nothing usable; provider OpenAI, current model id from OpenAI's models page
Step 2: Recognize `conductor integration add` needs a terminal on the machine holding the profile, which the user doesn't have here

Step 3: Give manual UI steps in words for acme.orkesconductor.com, without generating or guessing a URL: Integrations → New Integration → OpenAI, enter the key and save; Add Model → <id>; share it with default_app (Access Control → Applications → default_app → Integration tab); reply done
Step 4: End the turn and wait for the user's done
Step 5: Confirm with `integration-wait --type openai --model <id> --timeout 30`, then continue the task with the returned integration name
success_criteria: Does not ask the user to run `conductor integration add` (no terminal on this machine)
Gives the steps in words (Integrations → New Integration → OpenAI → key → Add Model → share with default_app) and does not generate or guess a link to a UI page
Includes the add-model and share-with-the-application steps
Never asks for the OpenAI key in chat
Ends the turn and waits for the user's done, then confirms with integration-wait and continues the original task
